body: CONCRETE STATIC-FIGURE REPAIR: parse the two unit lines from the checked-in captured output at Astro build time and fail closed unless both source/external values are finite, in [0,1], and sum to 1 within tolerance. Render a JS-free inline SVG titled Where each recall unit went: two horizontal 100% stacked bars, unit 0 labelled source 46.08% / external 53.92%, unit 1 labelled source 2.09% / external 97.91%. Put every value in visible text, use distinct fill plus pattern/border so meaning is not color-only, and include title/desc plus a prose table fallback. Deriving values from parsed output avoids another hand-transcription channel; a mutation court should change the SVG labels when the captured row changes and refuse malformed rows. Do not plot uniform coverage as a simple 0-of-71 count: it is mean posterior leaf visitation, not that count.
